_comment: SYNTHETIC ClinicalTrials.gov-shaped records for offline validation of the collector. These are invented, not real studies, and are never evidence for any research conclusion. NCT ids are deliberately non-existent (NCT09999xxx).

identificationModule.briefTitle: Individualised neoantigen mRNA vaccine plus pembrolizumab in resected melanoma (SYNTHETIC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 study of a personalised messenger RNA neoantigen vaccine with pembrolizumab in completely resected melanoma (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

interventions.name: Personalised mRNA neoantigen vaccine
interventions.description: Synthetic mRNA encoding patient-specific neoantigens, 1 mg intramuscularly every 3 weeks

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed completely resected melanoma; ECOG 0-1. Exclusion Criteria: Active autoimmune disease; pregnant or breast feeding women; prior immunotherapy.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Self-amplifying mRNA COVID-19 vaccine in healthy adults (SYNTHETIC)

interventions.name: saRNA SARS-CoV-2 vaccine
interventions.description: Self-amplifying mRNA vaccine for prevention of COVID-19

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: Healthy adults. Exclusion Criteria: Pregnant or breast feeding; prior immunotherapy; known lung disease.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy in relapsed B-cell lymphoma (SYNTHETIC)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: Relapsed refractory DLBCL. Exclusion Criteria: Pregnant or breast feeding; prior immunotherapy within 30 days.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Individualised mRNA neoantigen therapy in resected NSCLC, no India site (SYNTHETIC)

interventions.name: Individualised neoantigen mRNA therapy
interventions.description: messenger RNA encoding up to 34 patient-specific neoantigens

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: Completely resected stage II-IIIB NSCLC. Exclusion Criteria: Pregnant or breast feeding; prior immunotherapy.
